import hashlib,json,math,os,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'AppData/Local/Temp'
out=root/'llmx-q8-floor/three-rounds'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
arms={'llmx':root/'llmx-attention-values/validation/candidate-compare.exe','mx':Path.home()/'Desktop/Projects/llmx-ref/build/bin/Release/llmx-compare.exe'}
model=Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/snapshots/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf'
ids=root/'llmx-external-perf/eight-pairs/tokens.txt'
hashes={name:hashlib.file_digest(path.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest() for name,path in dict(arms,model=model,tokens=ids).items()}
(out/'hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,indent=2))
print(hashes,flush=True)
rows=[]
for pair in range(3):
    order=list(arms)
    if pair%2: order.reverse()
    for arm in order:
        p=subprocess.run([str(arms[arm]),str(model),str(ids)],capture_output=True,timeout=180)
        (out/f'{pair}-{arm}.stdout').write_bytes(p.stdout)
        (out/f'{pair}-{arm}.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr)
        p.check_returncode()
        samples=[json.loads(line) for line in p.stdout.decode().splitlines() if line]
        assert len(samples)==2 and samples[0]['run']==0 and samples[1]['run']==1
        row=dict(pair=pair,arm=arm,**samples[1])
        assert row['pp_tokens']==215 and row['tg_tokens']==32
        assert math.isfinite(row['logit_sum'])
        assert all(math.isfinite(row[k]) and row[k]>0 for k in ('pp_ms','tg_ms'))
        rows.append(row)
        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
        print(row,flush=True)
summary={}
for arm in arms:
    summary[arm]={}
    for phase in ('pp','tg'):
        rates=[r[phase+'_tokens']*1000/r[phase+'_ms'] for r in rows if r['arm']==arm]
        summary[arm][phase]=dict(mean=statistics.mean(rates),median=statistics.median(rates),minimum=min(rates),maximum=max(rates))
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
print(summary,flush=True)
